paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Meremar, “before Rav Pappa in Sheloshah SheAkhelu.” This is mistaken: chapter 7, Berakhot 45b, says Yehudah Mar bar Meremar, Rav Acha of Difti, and Mar bar Rav Ashi were equal in age and wisdom and came before Meremar. [The checked Berakhot calls him Yehudah bar Meremar.] Ketubot 52b, near the end: Rav Pappa told him, “Let the Master enter with me,” when going to Abba of Sura to write the marriage contract for his son's bride. There, 80b, beginning: Yehudah Mar bar Meremar in Rava's name.
